{{Quote|None of you were here.|Orson Krennic instructs discretion to the attendees at a secret Imperial meeting at the Maltheen Divide|<ref name="One Year Later" />}}
The '''Maltheen Divide''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="OYLAD">{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> in the [[Maltheen Divide system]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]]' [[Trax sector]]<ref name="Appendix" /> where, in [[4 BBY]], a [[Maltheen Divide conference|secret Imperial meeting]] occurred in a [[mountain]] [[Maltheen Divide lodge|lodge]] to discuss and plan for the [[Suppression of Ghorman|Imperial suppression]] of the planet [[Ghorman]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maltheen Divide appeared in "[[One Year Later]]," the debut episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor|Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
